@prefix cd: <https://growgraph.dev/facts/> . cd:kfos_elm_configuration opmad:has_text_value "KF estimates OS-ELM output weights without changing the network structure. Learning proceeds chunk-by-chunk. Initialization follows plain OS-ELM, using a small data chunk to compute the initial hidden-layer output matrix and output weights; initial variance P and observation-noise covariance R are also supplied. Output weights are KF state variables updated with each new data chunk. Training minimizes the trace of the output-weight error covariance with respect to the Kalman gain. R is nonnegative definite. Training finishes after the specified number of chunks, retaining the last updated output weights as the final network parameters." .
